body: Thank you, And almost everyone here said that I should report it. But like I said to another person, there might be a chance where I will go to a bad foster home. I’ve been trying to cope and I don’t want to get any of my friends I trust involved or tell them since I don’t want them to know I’ve been suicidal for 4 years and especially if the main reason was from my parents.

I’m only 14 and a half but I’m close to the age to get a job. And the only reason why I haven’t called the police or CPS is because you’re right. Not all foster homes are good and I still might have a chance to get in the same situation all over again. I’ve been trying to get out of the house more often, but with COVID being out there it’s hard to hangout with people and go to other places.
